precepts.text: They came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly. When Christ returns, these same people who had us in slavery will try to fight against him. And the devouring is secret: after the emancipation proclamation came the traps that still oppress us to this day.
precepts.point: Video played from a 1966 CBS documentary, Black Power, White Backlash, filmed in Cicero, Illinois, where 15,000 black people worked in the factories every day but not a single black family could live: residents said they would be afraid to go out at night, that you really could not trust any of them, and one said there are many good coloreds, but the ones that are going to march I don't like. They do not like when we march, because when we march we have our pride, our dignity, and our confidence. They do not like when we stand up as the nation of Israel; it angers them and it makes them afraid.

note.label: The Colossians & The CHRISTIANS of America

precepts.why:
Officer Tatum was asked if black men like him were better off during slavery, and he answered, 100 percent. He said that after slavery there was an explosion of success, black Wall Street, men married to the women they had children with, and now look at the inner cities. What he does not understand is that he thinks white people just switched and started loving us after they let us out of slavery.

“Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me”. When Christ returns, these same people who had us in slavery, and have us in slavery, are going to try to fight against Christ.

“their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.” These same slave owners rejoice to devour the poor, and they do it secretly. Even though slavery supposedly ended with the emancipation proclamation in 1863, then what? You had the school to prison pipeline. Redlining. Sundown towns. Sharecropping. It is still the same thing.

Look at us now, and why? Because he is setting up all these traps. That is why he is still oppressing us to this day, and that is the “yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” But Tatum cannot see that.

precepts.point: When I heard, my belly trembled, my lips quivered, rottenness entered my bones, that I might rest in the day of trouble. The prophets were inside the vision; they could feel the heat and smell the flesh, and Habakkuk did not want to live through it. When he cometh up unto the people he will invade them with his troops, which is why Trump created Space Force and why the UFO files are coming out: the aliens are the angels on the Lord's chariots.

note.label: Prophesy From Pain to Peace

precepts.why:
Habakkuk sees Christ coming: “Thy bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word.” The oaths of the tribes is the Bible. A bow in hand means you are coming for war, so according to the oaths of Jacob, Christ is coming for war. Zechariah shows what that bow is: “When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece”.

The Lord bends Judah for himself like a bow and fills the bow with Ephraim: Judah and Ephraim are the bow and the arrow. He raises up the sons of Zion, the rest of the twelve tribes, against the sons of Greece: against the Greeks, the white man. That is war.

That is why this tribulation will not be like any other we have gone through. There will be wars like we have never seen, and in the midst of world war Christ comes: Armageddon. “Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.” Indignation is righteous anger, and he beats the nations in it. The arrows and the glittering spear are the missiles being shot.

And the war is for his people alone: “Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even for salvation with thine anointed”. He is only coming to save the twelve tribes of Israel. “Thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked”: that is the white man, and America is the head, discovered “unto the neck” to make sure it is finished. Judah and Ephraim in his hand are how he does it.

precepts.text: When I heard, my belly trembled; when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.
precepts.point: Habakkuk 3:16, the prophet's belly trembled because he was put in it, and when he cometh up unto the people he will invade them with his troops. Isaiah 31:4, like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, the Lion of the tribe of Judah of Revelation 5:5, so shall the Lord of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion; as birds flying, Christ and the angels, he will defend Jerusalem, and passing over he will preserve it. Jeremiah 4:7, the lion is come up from his thicket, the destroyer of the Gentiles, Nebuchadnezzar contextually and Christ prophetically. 2 Esdras 11:37, a roaring lion chased out of the wood sends a man's voice unto the eagle, America.

note.label: The Beauty And The Beast

precepts.why:
Christ is returning with clouds, with his chariots and the multitude of angels. Habakkuk saw it: “When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself”. Why did he tremble? Because Habakkuk was put in it. He felt it; he saw it.

He trembled “that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.” When Christ comes up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops, the angels.

That is the day of trouble in which the Lord is the mighty protection and strong stay of them that love him. The prophet trembled at what he saw, but those who fear the Lord will rest in that day.

precepts.text: When I heard, my belly trembled, my lips quivered, rottenness entered into my bones, that I might rest in the day of trouble. Habakkuk saw the missiles hit and ten thousand fall at his side, and the anxiety sat in his chest; he said I do not want to be alive to see this.
precepts.point: Iran is destroying the world economy and bringing the dollar to nothing by cutting the oil that must be sold in dollars. Gas is already five dollars a gallon two weeks in. In my opinion, America will let it happen so it can introduce digital currency, and with it the digital ID that controls what you buy, eat, and wear. Every truck from the port to the warehouse to your store runs on gas, so food goes up, and the small businesses are already shutting down; the Bishop told you to buy food when it was cheap and you said Judah does not know what he is talking about.

note.label: The Storm Before the Kingdom

precepts.why:
God is “declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done.” Only the God of Israel can do that, and he shows the end to the prophets. Look at the videos of the missiles coming down at night: don't they look like stars falling from heaven? The prophets had never seen a missile, an Iron Dome, a supersonic missile or a nuclear weapon. They described what they saw to the best of their ability, and it is our job to put it together. Put yourself in the prophet's shoes, because you are the prophets; you just don't remember.

Habakkuk describes how it hurts when these missiles hit, because when they hit they bring destruction. You don't want to be around when a missile hits the ground; you don't even want to be ten feet away.

“When I heard, my belly trembled.” That kind of fear is an anxiety sitting inside you, in your chest. He cannot believe what he is watching, but the Lord had to show it to him. “My lips quivered at the voice”: he was shaking, he couldn't even talk straight. “Rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself.” He could not believe the damage this thing was doing, the number of people it killed when it hit.

“That I might rest in the day of trouble.” He is saying, I don't want to be alive to see this. It is so bad I don't want to be around to see it. That is what Psalms 91 means by a thousand falling at thy side and ten thousand at thy right hand: he saw the bomb drop and ten thousand people die right there.

That is the end God declared from the beginning, and “My counsel shall stand.” The media say Hamas is finished, Hezbollah has no weapons, Iran is weak; yet Hezbollah fired a hundred missiles into Israel the other day, and Israel cannot destroy Hamas under its nose while Iran is seven times bigger than Israel. We are going with the Bible. If you want the kingdom of heaven, you must accept what comes with it: war, tribulation and death.

note.label: Psalm 97: A Fire Goeth Before Him

precepts.why:
A fire goes before him and burns up his enemies round about: that is Christ coming back to destroy the nations. Habakkuk sees the same coming. “And his brightness was as the light; he had horns coming out of his hand: and there was the hiding of his power.” His power was hidden in the horns coming out of his hand.

“Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.” That is the fire that goes before him. “He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are everlasting.” He beholds and drives the nations asunder; the fire round about is his enemies, the nations, being burned up at his return.

precepts.why: Habakkuk sees a vision of Christ returning and destroying Babylon the great. “They came out as a whirlwind to scatter me”: the nations coming against Christ. “Their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly”: the poor are the Israelites. They will never say we hate you; they plant things among us, poison the water in Flint, Michigan, give bad education, and put abortion clinics, alcohol, drugs and guns in the communities, all done secretly. “Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, through the heap of great waters”: through great nations. “When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones”: he saw so much death that he got that sick feeling. That’s what John meant: it was bitter in my belly.

Every eye shall see him. When them chariots come everybody is going to see, like that movie V back in the day: there is an invasion. “When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself,” He was terrified by the visions he saw. “that I might rest in the day of trouble:” Habakkuk said, I want to be resting in the day of trouble; when the day of the Lord comes, please let me be at rest, I don't want to be alive walking around the earth.

“when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.” He will invade them with his troops. That is why you have movies called Invasion, Independence Day, Invasion of the Body Snatchers: all those movies about invasions come from the biblical text, the writings of our forefathers. That is where they get it from, but they make it little green men with big heads and eyeballs, take me to your leader, and here goes the white man saying he stuck me with something. Ain't nobody playing with your nasty behind, nasty white folks.
